decision.reason: These fields do not witness the dedicated A2 processing path. Generic jobs use mailbox offsets16/36, while fused A2 uses offset8/tag0xFC and increments its own nproc. Both paths coexist in the worker; this is not a claim that A2 executes on only one CPU.
decision.applicable_activity_gate: Keep exact image/identity/model, safe0, audio mode2 and amp-enabled checks; use two complete STAT replies with strictly increasing uint32 T.nproc for fresh A2 processing activity. A wrap, malformed or duplicate line must not be guessed. This does not prove acoustic quality or preset persistence.

FXS_eng.claim: Distinct variable from CLKSTATE eng; no assertion that it is the global A2 enable state.

FXS_posts.path: Generic function-pointer submit, not dedicated A2 mailbox publication.

FXS_takes.path: After generic call through mailbox+36 at0x01c04616.

CLKSTATE_eng.claim: Profile/state flag, not a completion counter; distinct from FXS eng.

STAT_T_nproc.claim: Incremented once after an A2 process call completes. Unarmed passthrough guard returns at0x01c0505c before this increment. The bounded worker-timeout fallback can compute synchronously then increment; this is activity, not proof of successful offload.

LVL_e.claim: Cost estimate/limit, not a monotonic activity counter. The profiled cost is stored at audio-state+512; global budget base is cost+500 at0x01c0283a..0x01c0284c. Actual observed134937/154950 and CLKSTATE base135437 satisfy this relation.

LVL_ci_co.claim: Clip counters; zero and non-increasing values are valid and must not block processing/preset tests.

STAT_response_contract.timing_regex: ^T nproc=(\d+) last=(\d+) max=(\d+) avg=(\d+) ticks; arena=(\d+) tick_ms=(\d+)/(\d+)$
STAT_response_contract.diagnostic_side_effects: After the final send, stores zero to audio-state+4100/+4104 (peak statistics) and DSP-state+80 (T.max). It does not reset nproc; it is not a configuration/NOR command.

rs_count_bounds.source: 0x02010266..0x02010274 clamps unsigned global1C1F180+48 to16 before the loop; loop0x020102FA..0x02010330 sends each item separately.

STAT_response_contract.framing_evidence: Although RS header/item format strings contain no newline, the CDC send wrapper inserts a newline before a new send if the prior send did not end in newline (0x02006E78..0x02006E8A, boundary flag updated0x02006EA2..0x02006EAE). Therefore RS header and each item are separate nonempty lines; actual WebSerial transcript confirms this.

limitations: No STAT command was sent by this agent. The real root-operated transcript is referenced and verified as input, not synthesized.
Counters prove execution paths only; audible output, clipping/noise and preset storage need their own real observations.
Zero generic counters do not prove a dead engine or a single-core implementation.
The generic FXS eng variable has not been given a speculative semantic name.

framing_correction.correction: The draft incorrectly inferred a single RS line from format strings; full send-wrapper control flow and the actual transcript establish one header plus n item lines. T.nproc provenance, final NIVEL terminator and all byte-identity comparisons are unchanged.
